Entry 1: field notes

Trail run this weekend: twelve miles, two river crossings and one very muddy dog. Hot take: the best coffee is the one somebody else makes for you on a Monday.

Entry 2: field notes

Learning to play the cello at forty is humbling, but the progress feels great. Our community garden harvested over two hundred pounds of tomatoes this season.

Entry 3: field notes

The library extended its weekend hours, which is great news for students nearby. Tried the new ramen place on Fifth Street and the broth was rich and deeply savory.

Entry 4: field notes

Volunteering at the animal shelter this Saturday, they always need extra hands. Spent the morning repotting the fiddle leaf fig and it finally looks happy again.

Entry 5: field notes

Does anyone have a good recipe for sourdough that works with whole wheat flour? The sunset over the harbor tonight was unreal, the whole sky turned a deep orange.
